artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Imports the DB-b-21 script by path (and through it the DB-b-20 script). plan is offline (S3 list reads, DRY_RUN=1). run and sweep refuse without --go, without the plan, and without the ruling object; run also refuses a plan not re-derived identically. One coordinator mints the shared bearer; 2 then 6 workers on one queue and one rate limiter; one retry per call; FAILED recorded; abort rules per batches 249/250. run and sweep were never run.

14 offline pytest tests (stub boto3, helpers, clock and sleep): shared bearer minted by the coordinator alone, ramp 2 to 6, 429 halving and one retry after backoff, FAILED recorded and run continues, 3 consecutive abort, FAILED above failed_cap aborts, 401 fresh stops and 401 older re-mints, landed never requested and none twice, checkpoint cadence, other 4xx and landing failure abort, run and sweep refuse without --go, sweep set refusal, plan ruling and denominators.
Built by plan under DRY_RUN=1 from S3 list reads: planned 5252 = landed 144 + complement 5108, vendor_calls 0, 0 landed keys outside the plan, ruling object with the batch 249/250 values.
